editorApprovedScope.userApproval: User answered Yes to assessing the main Jonathan Sacks–Richard Dawkins conversation before audience questions, excluding substantive moderator interventions and directly dependent replies, with reader-facing scope disclosure. Exact boundaries remain to be verified.
editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: This assessment covers selected, self-contained Jonathan Sacks–Richard Dawkins exchanges within the main conversation, approximately 2:09–41:54. Substantive moderator interventions and their dependent replies are excluded, removing approximately 20:31 (51.6%) of that window and leaving approximately 19:14 of eligible conversation. The exclusions include host-led exchanges about book tone, selective evidence, divine intervention, religious upbringing, antisemitism, and moral necessity. Introductions and all audience Q&A are also unscored. Neither speaker receives credit or penalty for excluded material; the scores do not assess the complete event.

excludedIntervals.reason: The moderator introduces the accusation of aggressive, jeering confrontation and Dawkins answers that characterization. Exclude the complete tone discussion and immediate follow-up; retain his subsequent explicit return to Sacks's independently stated how/why distinction.

The moderator states that religious thinkers opportunistically invoke evidence but claim an opt-out when it is absent. Exclude this substantive framing and Dawkins's full immediate reply, including the connected DNA explanation; neither side receives credit or penalty for this exchange.

The moderator presses the relevance to science and the factual occurrence of divine intervention. Exclude the whole continuous host-led branch, Sacks's power-of-the-powerless explanation, Dawkins's denial of the event, and the conditional rejoinder. Resume only at Dawkins's new Adam-and-Eve question.

The moderator advances the counterexample that increasing numbers read scripture literally. Exclude her claim and Sacks's dependent oral-tradition/heresy reply. The following neutral request about Abraham and Isaac is a fresh topic prompt, not an argument supplied by the moderator.

Conservatively exclude the uninterrupted chain beginning with the moderator's teacher/obedience anecdote, followed by the Christian-reading and antisemitism dispute, compulsory-belief/faith-school framing, admissions and quasi-racial identity objections, and the claimed need for religion to supply ethics. Exclude all directly dependent answers and rebuttals, including both sides' replies on moral necessity. Resume at Sacks's separately introduced empirical Putnam evidence, which supplies its own warrant without requiring the excluded premise.

Sacks explicitly recapitulates the excluded claim that religion is not needed to know what to do; the moderator then proposes a Darwinian-survival inference. Exclude that dependent concession, its connected ritual gloss, the host inference, and the overlapping immediate reactions. Dawkins's separate methodological question about the independently retained Putnam evidence is eligible afterward.

Dawkins expressly invokes his earlier, excluded century/decade argument; Sacks responds by discussing religion's resistance to the zeitgeist. Exclude this entire dependent exchange so an omitted argument supplies neither a scored premise nor a scored rebuttal. Resume when Dawkins explicitly returns to the independently retained community mechanism.

editorApprovedScope.boundaryBasis: Complete original upload transcribed in timestamp-preserving chunks, two cross-boundary sentences independently verified, and all source speech reviewed against the official publisher transcript. The opening substantive case starts at 129.200 seconds; the final complete main-conversation reply ends at 2513.720 seconds, immediately before the invitation to audience questions.
editorApprovedScope.outsideWindowDisposition: Unscored introduction and pleasantries before the opening substantive case; all audience questions and answers excluded. The recording itself ends during a final Q&A answer.
editorApprovedScope.coherenceReview: Retained exchanges contain their own premises: scientific partnership and cosmic purpose, symbolic/literal readings, Abraham and Isaac, independently introduced empirical community evidence and its methodological challenge, prospective secular community, religious persistence, and closing common ground. Dependent chains are excluded conservatively; no omitted rebuttal may be treated as silence.

captionCaution: Audio-derived automatic transcripts contain recognition errors, occasional repeated boundary words, approximate timing, and mixed-speaker short interjections. Do not penalize these as participant defects or silently correct quotations. Named turn annotations are controller attributions checked against the official speaker-labelled transcript, not automatic identification or direct listening. Mark any meaningful remaining attribution/wording uncertainty below high and explain the required check. Excluded host-led exchanges and Q&A may supply no premise, reply, burden, concession, or omission penalty. Dawkins is not assigned a proof that no God exists or a complete naturalistic account where he only challenges a religious inference.

requirements: Read this entire packet, all 378 scoped indexed transcript lines, all scoped-events JSON, and validator lines 1–461 literally in bounded untruncated output. Write only the reading audit and report ranges to the controller, then WAIT for authenticated release before drafting.

Inventory only. No ratings, scores, critiques, tags, winner, other debates, Git history, web research, excluded source, credentials, paid calls or other agent contexts. Use API-key-free commands. One initial attempt.

Freeze the supplied motion and identities verbatim. Sacks defends a religious partnership with science; Dawkins challenges religious explanatory and interpretive warrants while acknowledging possible community benefits. Do not assign the critic unadopted contrary burdens.

The eligible source is a disclosed selection of self-contained main-conversation exchanges under explicit user approval. Gaps are deliberate. Never fill them with imagination, outside knowledge, full unscoped source, or prior context; never count an excluded response as silence or concede an excluded premise.

Select source-led 4–7 semantic sections weighted to 100 and 8–48 moves, at most four per side per section. Three are ordinary. Every fourth needs a frozen independently complete, nonmergeable argument rationale. Each section must have both sides but no fabricated paired replies. Semantic grouping may combine separated eligible parts when their argumentative relation is explicit.
Give each side 3–7 burden bridges, exactly one motion and at least one central and one subsidiary. Importance is 1–3, based on motion significance and not predicted strength.

Use original eventIndex values, not scoped array positions. Every source span must be contiguous in original event indices and wholly eligible. Select the smallest complete claim/reason, target 30–90 words and at most 2200 characters unless source-specific necessity is documented. Do not incorporate a substantive opponent or moderator turn into one speaker move.

Use semantic lowercase move and section IDs. Replies target earlier selected moves and identify which component is answered. If the live antecedent was excluded, do not invent a response link or treat it as a scored constructive claim by removing its dependency.

Coverage audit must account for every load-bearing eligible phase, concession, repetition and omission. Explicitly audit the retained DNA analogy, cosmic-purpose exchange, symbolic/literal test, Abraham/Isaac exchange, independently warranted community evidence and challenge, secular-community prospect, future religion exchange, and closing dignity/common-ground claims; selection and sectioning remain source-led.

Provide exact recomputable selectionBalanceAudit and publicationCapacityAudit. Totals threshold 3 and section difference threshold 2 require specific source rationale. The controller independently recalculates counts and verifies every fourth-row authorization before judgments.

Draft JSON fields: motion, routes, sections, moves, coverageAudit, speakerAttributionReview, selectionBalanceAudit, publicationCapacityAudit. Each move: moveId, side, speaker, sectionId, moveKind (constructive/reply), claim, warrant, inference, startEvent, endEvent, quoteEligibleExactSpans (exact 3–18-word substrings), attributionConfidence, attributionRationale, audioVerificationReason, importance, importanceRationale, burdenContact (bridgeId,tier,rationale), respondsToIds, responseComponents (targetMoveId,component,rationale).

Named turn annotations support but do not compel high confidence. Transcript errors are not argument defects. Mark meaningful uncertainties below high; explain the audio check and never claim to have listened. Keep quotations out of misrecognitions and boundary artifacts. Do not improve the spoken argument.
Use apply_patch for allowed output files only. Do not write inventory.json; the controller compiles exact source spans after independent review. No inferred or model-authored scores.
